properties.description: Built 2026-10-18 (item 3 of req:a-proof-can-state-a-contradiction-cases-suppositions-and-cited-theorems). `statement_kind: hypothesis` on a Requirement or Constraint: a reductio's supposition, an induction hypothesis, a case of a split. statement_reading reads `assumed` while a step takes it up and none discharges it, `discharged` once one does (by `discharges` or `cases`), and `not_assumed` when no step takes it up; it is never taken as given. Trial shapes: Arrow N20 and π+e P3, where a hypothesis read "stated, not shown".
properties.name: A supposition or hypothesis has a statement kind of its own and reads assumed or discharged, never stated-not-shown
